## Summary

In `support/urdf/online_planning_example.{urdf,xacro}` the `human_estop_zone` link has a visual origin of `z = 1` but a collision origin of `z = 0`. Both use `cylinder length="2"`. The drawn cylinder spans z 0..2 m, the collision cylinder spans z -1..1 m. Collision checking therefore sees a different volume than the one displayed.

`robot_estop_zone` in the same file uses `z = 1` for both visual and collision, so the human zone looks like a typo.

## Excerpt

`support/urdf/online_planning_example.urdf:396-411` (same block at `online_planning_example.xacro:64-79`):

```xml
<link name="human_estop_zone">
  <visual>
    <origin rpy="0 0 0" xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <geometry>
      <cylinder length="2" radius="0.5"/>
    </geometry>
    <material name="estop_red"/>
  </visual>
  <collision>
    <origin rpy="0 0 0" xyz="0 0 0"/>
    <geometry>
      <cylinder length="2" radius="0.5"/>
    </geometry>
    <material name="estop_red"/>
  </collision>
</link>
```

The link hangs off `human_y` (`human_estop_zone` joint, identity origin), which is under `human_x` under `floor`, so the link frame is on the floor (z = 0).

Checked at tesseract `f4cc0807bbe5d975f25cb2aadae313404d4a8b11`; the two files are identical on `origin/master` (`7e2d803cee5de1524e5ea5565fba94859ae27709`).

## Expected vs actual

| | z range (m) |
|---|---|
| visual (drawn) | 0 .. 2 |
| collision (checked) | -1 .. 1 |

- Collision geometry reaches 1 m below the floor plane and stops 1 m short of the top of the drawn person.
- An obstacle between z = 1 and 2 m (e.g. a robot link at head height) is drawn inside the zone but not detected.
- An obstacle between z = -1 and 0 m is detected but cannot be seen.

## Likely intent

A person standing on the floor occupies 0..2 m, matching the visual and matching `robot_estop_zone`. The collision origin should be `0 0 1`.

## Proposed fix

One line per file: collision `<origin>` of `human_estop_zone` from `xyz="0 0 0"` to `xyz="0 0 1"`. See `fix.patch` (covers both the xacro source and the generated urdf).
new_candidates.title: online_planning_example: `human_estop_zone` collision cylinder sits 1 m below its visual
